guide.summary: 刚才 is a time noun like 昨天: it names a moment a few minutes ago and behaves like any time word. 刚 / 刚刚 is an adverb like 已经: it sits right before the verb and says the action is only just done, measured against now or against any time you name (去年刚毕业). Ask: am I naming WHEN (刚才) or saying ONLY JUST (刚)?

subs.label: Before or after the subject
subs.focus: 刚才 may stand before or after the subject; 刚/刚刚 must come after the subject, directly before the verb. Make the learner pick the word for a given slot (sentence-initial = 刚才) or place 刚 in an order item. Classic mistake: starting the sentence with 刚 as if it were 'just now'.

subs.label: 刚才的 + noun
subs.focus: Only the time noun 刚才 can modify a noun (刚才的事, 刚才那个人, 刚才的电话) or stand as a noun after 比/跟/从 (比刚才好多了). The learner must reject 刚 in these noun slots. Classic mistake: 刚的事, 比刚好.

subs.label: 刚才 + 没 / 不
subs.focus: A negated verb or an ongoing state/background situation takes 刚才, not 刚: 刚才没听见, 刚才为什么不说, 刚才不在. 刚 needs a positive action that has just happened. The learner must pick 刚才 when 没/不 follows. Classic mistake: 我刚没听见 in careful standard usage.

subs.label: 刚 + verb + duration
subs.focus: With a time span after the verb (刚来两天, 刚学了三个月, 刚认识一个星期) only 刚/刚刚 works, meaning 'has only been ... for'. 刚才 cannot combine with a duration that reaches up to now. Classic mistake: 我刚才来两天.

subs.label: Sentence-final 了
subs.focus: 刚才 reports a past event and normally keeps 了 (刚才他走了). 刚/刚刚 takes a bare verb or verb + result with no sentence-final 了 (他刚走, 我刚吃完). Test 刚 vs 刚才 from the presence or absence of final 了, or 了 vs ∅ after 刚. Classic mistake: 他刚走了.

subs.label: 刚 … 就 …
subs.focus: 'No sooner A than B': 刚/刚刚 in the first clause, 就 in the second (我刚到家，就下雨了). 刚才 cannot fill this slot because it names a time, it does not link two events. Classic mistake: 我刚才到家，就下雨了 for 'as soon as'.

subs.label: 刚 with another time word; 刚才 = minutes ago
subs.focus: 刚 is relative: it follows any other time word (去年刚毕业, 昨天刚买的) and can mean recent on a scale of months. 刚才 is itself the time word, means only minutes ago, and cannot follow another time word. Classic mistake: 他去年刚才毕业, or 刚才 for something from this morning or last week.

rules.rule: 刚才 is a time word: put it before or after the subject, just like 昨天.
rules.pattern: 刚才 + Subject + Verb + 了 / Subject + 刚才 + Verb + 了

examples.py: gāng cái wǒ kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng le
examples.en: I saw Xiao Wang a moment ago.

examples.py: nǐ gāng cái qù nǎ r le
examples.en: Where did you go just now?

examples.py: gāng cái shéi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
examples.en: Who called me a moment ago?

rules.rule: 刚 / 刚刚 is an adverb: it goes after the subject and directly before the verb.

examples.py: wǒ gāng dào gōng sī
examples.en: I've only just got to the office.

examples.py: tā gāng gāng chū qù
examples.en: He has just gone out.

examples.py: wǒ men gāng chī wán wǎn fàn
examples.en: We've just finished dinner.

rules.note: In fast casual speech some speakers do put 刚刚 (and occasionally 刚) before the subject as a short form of 刚才. In standard usage, and in these drills, only 刚才 goes before the subject.

rules.rule: To say 'the ... from just now', use 刚才 + 的 + noun, or 刚才 + 那 / 这 + measure + noun. 刚 cannot modify a noun.
rules.pattern: 刚才 + 的 + Noun / 刚才 + 那 + measure + Noun

examples.py: gāng cái de shì nǐ bié gào su tā
examples.en: Don't tell him about what happened just now.

examples.py: gāng cái nà gè rén shì shéi
examples.en: Who was that person just now?

examples.py: gāng cái de diàn huà shì shéi dǎ de
examples.en: Who was that phone call from just now?

rules.rule: After 比 / 跟 / 和, the thing compared with must be a noun, so only 刚才 fits.

examples.py: xiàn zài bǐ gāng cái hǎo duō le
examples.en: It's much better now than a moment ago.

examples.py: yǔ bǐ gāng cái xiǎo le
examples.en: The rain is lighter than it was a moment ago.

examples.py: zhè r gēn gāng cái yī yàng rè
examples.en: It's as hot here as it was a moment ago.

rules.rule: If the verb is negated with 没 or 不, use 刚才. 刚 says something has just happened, so it does not go with something that did not happen.
rules.pattern: Subject + 刚才 + 没 / 不 + Verb

examples.zh: 对不起，我刚才没听清楚。
examples.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng chu
examples.en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly just now.

examples.zh: 你刚才为什么不告诉我？
examples.py: nǐ gāng cái wèi shén me bù gào su wǒ
examples.en: Why didn't you tell me just now?

examples.py: gāng cái tā bù zài bàn gōng shì
examples.en: He wasn't in the office a moment ago.

rules.note: In casual speech you will hear 我刚没听清, with 刚 as a clipped 刚才. Treat it as colloquial; the safe standard form is 刚才 + 没 / 不.

rules.rule: 'Have only been doing it for X': 刚 + verb + duration. 刚才 is impossible here.

examples.zh: 我刚来两天，还不认识路。
examples.py: wǒ gāng lái liǎng tiān hái bù rèn shi lù
examples.en: I've only been here two days and don't know the way yet.

examples.py: tā gāng xué le sān gè yuè hàn yǔ
examples.en: He has only been learning Chinese for three months.

examples.py: wǒ men gāng rèn shi yī gè xīng qī
examples.en: We've only known each other for a week.

rules.note: Verb-了 before the duration is fine (刚学了三个月); what 刚 avoids is the sentence-final 了.

rules.rule: 刚才 + event: keep 了, as with any past time word. 刚 + verb: no sentence-final 了; the bare verb or verb + result is enough.
rules.pattern: Subject + 刚才 + Verb + 了 / Subject + 刚 + Verb (+ result)

examples.py: tā gāng cái zǒu le
examples.en: He left a moment ago.

examples.py: tā gāng zǒu
examples.en: He has only just left.

examples.py: gāng cái xià yǔ le
examples.en: It rained a moment ago.

examples.py: wǒ gāng xià bān
examples.en: I've just got off work.

rules.note: This is a strong tendency, not an iron law: sentences like 他刚走了 are occasionally heard, but they sound off to most speakers and are marked wrong in exams. 刚才 without 了 is normal when the verb is negated or describes a state (刚才我在睡觉).

rules.rule: 'As soon as / no sooner ... than': 刚 in the first clause, 就 before the second verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 刚 + Verb 1 + ， + (Subject 2) + 就 + Verb 2 + 了

examples.py: wǒ gāng dào jiā jiù xià yǔ le
examples.en: I had only just got home when it started to rain.

examples.py: tā gāng zuò xià diàn huà jiù xiǎng le
examples.en: He had just sat down when the phone rang.

examples.zh: 我刚想给你打电话，你就来了。
examples.py: wǒ gāng xiǎng gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà nǐ jiù lái le
examples.en: I was just about to call you when you turned up.

rules.note: 就 is an adverb too: it follows the second subject (电话就响了, not 就电话响了).

rules.rule: 刚 can follow any other time word and means 'only just, at that time'. How recent is up to the speaker: it can be last year.

examples.py: tā qù nián gāng bì yè
examples.en: He only graduated last year.

examples.zh: 这件衣服是我昨天刚买的。
examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì wǒ zuó tiān gāng mǎi de
examples.en: I only bought this piece of clothing yesterday.

examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang gāng dào běi jīng
examples.en: I only arrived in Beijing this morning.

rules.rule: 刚才 is itself the time word: a few minutes ago, still the same scene. It cannot be combined with 昨天, 去年 and the like, or used for things hours or days back.
rules.pattern: 刚才 = a few minutes ago (no second time word)

examples.py: gāng cái yǒu rén zhǎo nǐ
examples.en: Someone was looking for you a moment ago.

examples.py: nǐ gāng cái shuō shén me
examples.en: What did you say just now?

examples.zh: 我刚才在楼下看见他了。
examples.py: wǒ gāng cái zài lóu xià kàn jiàn tā le
examples.en: I saw him downstairs a moment ago.

right.py: gāng cái wǒ kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng le
right.en: I saw Xiao Wang a moment ago.

contrasts.why: Before the subject you need the time noun 刚才. 刚 is an adverb and must sit after the subject, right before the verb.

right.py: gāng cái de shì zhēn duì bu qǐ
right.en: I'm really sorry about what happened just now.

contrasts.why: Only a noun can take 的 and modify another noun. 刚才 is a noun; 刚 is not.

right.py: wǒ gāng lái zhōng guó liǎng gè yuè
right.en: I've only been in China for two months.

contrasts.why: A duration up to now needs the adverb 刚. 刚才 means a few minutes ago, which clashes with two months.

right.py: tā qù nián gāng bì yè

contrasts.why: 刚才 is already a time word (minutes ago) and cannot follow 去年. 刚 is relative and happily follows any time word.

right.en: The teacher has only just left.

contrasts.why: 刚 already says the action is just completed, so sentence-final 了 is dropped. With 刚才 you would keep it: 老师刚才走了.

contrasts.wrong: 我刚才躺下，孩子就哭了。

right.py: wǒ gāng tǎng xià hái zi jiù kū le
right.en: I had only just lain down when the child started crying.

contrasts.why: 'No sooner ... than' is 刚 … 就 …. 刚才 only names a time and cannot pair with 就 to link two events.

right.zh: 你刚才为什么不接电话？
right.py: nǐ gāng cái wèi shén me bù jiē diàn huà
right.en: Why didn't you pick up the phone just now?

contrasts.why: A negated verb goes with the time noun 刚才. 刚 marks something that has just happened, not something that did not happen.

right.py: xiàn zài bǐ gāng cái shū fu duō le
right.en: I feel much better now than a moment ago.

contrasts.why: 比 compares two nouns: 现在 and 刚才. The adverb 刚 cannot stand after 比.

cheat: Slot before the subject? 刚才.
的 or a noun right after it, or 比 before it? 刚才.
没 or 不 follows? 刚才.
Duration after the verb (两天, 三个月)? 刚.
就 in the next clause? 刚.
Another time word in front (昨天, 去年)? 刚, never 刚才.
Sentence ends in 了 → think 刚才; bare verb, no 了 → think 刚.

items.q: ___我在开会，没接电话。
items.zh: 刚才我在开会，没接电话。
items.py: gāng cái wǒ zài kāi huì méi jiē diàn huà
items.en: I was in a meeting a moment ago and did not answer the phone.
items.why: Before the subject only the time noun 刚才 fits, and the negated 没接 points the same way. The adverb 刚 must sit after the subject, right before the verb.

items.q: ___谁给我打电话了？
items.zh: 刚才谁给我打电话了？
items.py: gāng cái shéi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
items.en: Who called me a moment ago?
items.why: A slot in front of the subject needs a time word, and 刚才 is the one that means a moment ago. 刚 is an adverb and cannot lead the sentence; 明天 and 每天 do not fit the cue.

items.q: 你___去哪儿了？我找了你很久。
items.zh: 你刚才去哪儿了？我找了你很久。
items.py: nǐ gāng cái qù nǎ r le wǒ zhǎo le nǐ hěn jiǔ
items.en: Where did you go just now? I looked for you for ages.
items.why: 刚才 is a time noun that can follow the subject and keeps the final 了 of a past event. 刚好 means just right, 马上 means at once, and 一直 means all along; none of them says a moment ago.

items.q: ___经理叫你去办公室，你不在。
items.zh: 刚才经理叫你去办公室，你不在。
items.py: gāng cái jīng lǐ jiào nǐ qù bàn gōng shì nǐ bù zài
items.en: The manager asked for you at his office a moment ago, but you were not in.
items.why: The sentence opens with a time word before the subject 经理, so it must be 刚才. 一会儿 would point to the future, and 刚 cannot stand before a subject.

items.q: ___医生来看你，你在睡觉。
items.zh: 刚才医生来看你，你在睡觉。
items.py: gāng cái yī shēng lái kàn nǐ nǐ zài shuì jiào
items.en: The doctor came to see you a moment ago while you were asleep.
items.why: A time word at the head of the clause is 刚才, which also suits the background state 你在睡觉. 刚 belongs after 医生, and 最近 or 明年 do not match the cue.

items.q: ___会议室里的空调坏了，大家都热得受不了，现在已经修好了。
items.zh: 刚才会议室里的空调坏了，大家都热得受不了，现在已经修好了。
items.py: gāng cái huì yì shì lǐ de kōng tiáo huài le dà jiā dōu rè de shòu bù liǎo xiàn zài yǐ jīng xiū hǎo le
items.en: A moment ago the air conditioning in the meeting room broke and everyone was unbearably hot; it has been fixed now.
items.why: The opening slot before the subject 空调 takes the time noun 刚才, contrasted with 现在 later on. 刚 would have to follow 空调, and 已经 or 马上 do not name the earlier moment.

items.q: ___我的头很疼，现在好一点儿了。
items.zh: 刚才我的头很疼，现在好一点儿了。
items.py: gāng cái wǒ de tóu hěn téng xiàn zài hǎo yī diǎn r le
items.en: My head hurt a lot a moment ago, but it is a little better now.
items.why: 刚才 is contrasted with 现在 and stands before the subject 我的头. 刚 cannot open a sentence, and 等一下 or 明天 would refer to the future.

items.q: ___老板在会上说的话，大家都听清楚了。
items.zh: 刚才老板在会上说的话，大家都听清楚了。
items.py: gāng cái lǎo bǎn zài huì shàng shuō de huà dà jiā dōu tīng qīng chu le
items.en: Everyone heard clearly what the boss said at the meeting just now.
items.why: The whole phrase 老板在会上说的话 is the topic and 刚才 sits in front of it as a time word. 刚 and 刚好 cannot head the phrase, and 已经 cannot come before the topic noun.

items.q: ___的电话是谁打的？
items.zh: 刚才的电话是谁打的？
items.py: gāng cái de diàn huà shì shéi dǎ de
items.en: Who was that phone call from just now?
items.why: 的 links a noun to the noun it modifies, and only the time noun 刚才 can do that. 刚 is an adverb and cannot take 的.

items.q: 你还记得___那个人吗？
items.zh: 你还记得刚才那个人吗？
items.py: nǐ hái jì de gāng cái nà gè rén ma
items.en: Do you still remember the person from just now?
items.why: 刚才 modifies the noun phrase 那个人 as a time noun. The adverb 刚 cannot sit in front of a noun, and 才 and 就 do not do that either.

items.q: 我的头现在比___好多了。
items.zh: 我的头现在比刚才好多了。
items.py: wǒ de tóu xiàn zài bǐ gāng cái hǎo duō le
items.en: My head is much better now than a moment ago.
items.why: 比 needs a noun to compare with 现在, so it takes the noun 刚才. 刚 is an adverb and cannot follow 比.

items.q: 你别把___的事告诉经理。
items.zh: 你别把刚才的事告诉经理。
items.py: nǐ bié bǎ gāng cái de shì gào su jīng lǐ
items.en: Do not tell the manager what happened just now.
items.why: 刚才的事 is a noun phrase, the object of 把. The adverb 刚 cannot take 的 to modify 事.

items.q: 这个房间比___凉快多了。
items.zh: 这个房间比刚才凉快多了。
items.py: zhè gè fáng jiān bǐ gāng cái liáng kuai duō le
items.en: This room is much cooler than it was a moment ago.
items.why: The thing compared with after 比 must be a noun. 刚才 is a time noun; 刚 is an adverb and cannot follow 比.

items.q: 你能再说一遍___医生说的话吗？
items.zh: 你能再说一遍刚才医生说的话吗？
items.py: nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn gāng cái yī shēng shuō de huà ma
items.en: Could you repeat what the doctor said just now?
items.why: 刚才 modifies the whole phrase 医生说的话 as a time noun. An adverb like 刚, 才 or 就 cannot attach to a noun phrase.

items.q: ___那封邮件是谁发来的？
items.zh: 刚才那封邮件是谁发来的？
items.py: gāng cái nà fēng yóu jiàn shì shéi fā lái de
items.en: Who sent that email from a moment ago?
items.why: 刚才 stands in front of 那封邮件 and works like a noun modifier. The adverb 刚 must go before a verb, and 才 and 就 do not fit before a noun phrase.

items.q: 我觉得这个方案比___那个方案更合适。
items.zh: 我觉得这个方案比刚才那个方案更合适。
items.py: wǒ jué de zhè gè fāng àn bǐ gāng cái nà gè fāng àn gèng hé shì
items.en: I think this plan is more suitable than the one from a moment ago.
items.why: 比 introduces a noun phrase, and 刚才那个方案 is one with 刚才 as the time noun. 刚 cannot sit between 比 and a noun.

items.q: 医生说我的体温跟___一样高，还得再观察一会儿。
items.zh: 医生说我的体温跟刚才一样高，还得再观察一会儿。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ de tǐ wēn gēn gāng cái yī yàng gāo hái děi zài guān chá yī huì r
items.en: The doctor said my temperature is as high as it was a moment ago and that I need to be watched a little longer.
items.why: 跟 ... 一样 compares two nouns, and 刚才 is the time noun standing for the earlier reading. 刚 is an adverb and cannot follow 跟.

items.q: ___的会议记录你整理好了吗？
items.zh: 刚才的会议记录你整理好了吗？
items.py: gāng cái de huì yì jì lù nǐ zhěng lǐ hǎo le ma
items.en: Have you tidied up the minutes of the meeting we just had?
items.why: 的 turns 刚才 into a modifier of 会议记录, which only a noun can be. The adverb 刚 cannot take 的.

items.q: 你___为什么不告诉我？
items.zh: 你刚才为什么不告诉我？
items.py: nǐ gāng cái wèi shén me bù gào su wǒ
items.en: Why did you not tell me just now?
items.why: A negated verb (不告诉) goes with the time noun 刚才. 刚 reports something that has just happened, not something that did not happen.

items.q: ___他不在办公室，现在回来了。
items.zh: 刚才他不在办公室，现在回来了。
items.py: gāng cái tā bù zài bàn gōng shì xiàn zài huí lái le
items.en: He was not in the office a moment ago; he is back now.
items.why: 刚才 opens the clause and describes a state, 不在, contrasted with 现在. 刚 needs a positive action that has just taken place.

items.q: 你___怎么没接电话？
items.zh: 你刚才怎么没接电话？
items.py: nǐ gāng cái zěn me méi jiē diàn huà
items.en: Why did you not answer the phone just now?
items.why: The question is about a moment ago and the verb is negated (没接), so the time noun 刚才 is used. 已经, 才 and 就 are adverbs that do not mean a moment ago.

items.q: 我___没带手机，所以没看到你的信息。
items.zh: 我刚才没带手机，所以没看到你的信息。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái méi dài shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi kàn dào nǐ de xìn xī
items.en: I did not have my phone with me a moment ago, so I did not see your message.
items.why: 没带手机 is a negated verb, so the time noun 刚才 is used. 已经, 才 and 马上 do not mean a moment ago.

items.q: 护士___不让我喝水，现在可以了。
items.zh: 护士刚才不让我喝水，现在可以了。
items.py: hù shi gāng cái bù ràng wǒ hē shuǐ xiàn zài kě yǐ le
items.en: The nurse would not let me drink water a moment ago, but now I can.
items.why: 不让 is negative and set against 现在 later in the sentence, so the time noun 刚才 is needed. 刚 cannot stand before 不.

items.q: 我___头不疼，怎么现在突然疼起来了？
items.zh: 我刚才头不疼，怎么现在突然疼起来了？
items.py: wǒ gāng cái tóu bù téng zěn me xiàn zài tū rán téng qǐ lái le
items.en: My head did not hurt a moment ago; why does it suddenly hurt now?
items.why: 头不疼 describes a state that was true a moment ago, a job for 刚才. 刚 needs a positive action just completed, and 已经 would flip the meaning.

items.q: 你___没吃药吗？医生让你饭后马上吃。
items.zh: 你刚才没吃药吗？医生让你饭后马上吃。
items.py: nǐ gāng cái méi chī yào ma yī shēng ràng nǐ fàn hòu mǎ shàng chī
items.en: Did you not take your medicine just now? The doctor told you to take it right after eating.
items.why: 没 negates 吃药 and the question is about a moment ago, so 刚才 is used. 已经, 才 and 马上 do not fit that meaning.

items.q: 老板___不同意这个计划，怎么现在又改变主意了？
items.zh: 老板刚才不同意这个计划，怎么现在又改变主意了？
items.py: lǎo bǎn gāng cái bù tóng yì zhè gè jì huà zěn me xiàn zài yòu gǎi biàn zhǔ yi le
items.en: The boss did not agree to this plan a moment ago; how come he has changed his mind now?
items.why: 不同意 is a negated verb contrasted with 现在, so the time noun 刚才 is required. 刚 only suits a positive action that has just happened.

items.q: 我___一直没听清楚你说的话，因为旁边的人声音太大了。
items.zh: 我刚才一直没听清楚你说的话，因为旁边的人声音太大了。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái yī zhí méi tīng qīng chu nǐ shuō de huà yīn wèi páng biān de rén shēng yīn tài dà le
items.en: I could not hear clearly what you were saying a moment ago because the people next to us were too loud.
items.why: 一直没听清楚 is a negated, continuing situation, which needs the time word 刚才. 刚 cannot cover a stretch of not hearing.

items.q: 他___不舒服，没去吃午饭，现在好多了。
items.zh: 他刚才不舒服，没去吃午饭，现在好多了。
items.py: tā gāng cái bù shū fu méi qù chī wǔ fàn xiàn zài hǎo duō le
items.en: He was not feeling well a moment ago and did not go to lunch; he is much better now.
items.why: 不舒服 and 没去 are both negative or state descriptions of a recent moment, so 刚才 is needed. 刚 cannot describe a state that did not hold.

items.q: 我___来两天，还不认识路。
items.zh: 我刚来两天，还不认识路。
items.py: wǒ gāng lái liǎng tiān hái bù rèn shi lù
items.en: I have only been here for two days and I do not know the way yet.
items.why: A duration after the verb (两天) is a stretch up to now, which takes the adverb 刚. 刚才 means a few minutes ago and clashes with two days.

items.q: 他___学了三个月汉语。
items.zh: 他刚学了三个月汉语。
items.py: tā gāng xué le sān gè yuè hàn yǔ
items.en: He has only been studying Chinese for three months.
items.why: 刚 + verb + duration means has only been doing it for that long. 刚才 cannot combine with 三个月, and 正在 cannot be followed by a duration.

items.q: 我们___认识一个星期。
items.zh: 我们刚认识一个星期。
items.py: wǒ men gāng rèn shi yī gè xīng qī
items.en: We have only known each other for a week.
items.why: The duration 一个星期 reaching up to now needs 刚. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back, not a week-long span.

items.q: 我___在这家公司工作了半年，还不太熟悉工作。
items.zh: 我刚在这家公司工作了半年，还不太熟悉工作。
items.py: wǒ gāng zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le bàn nián hái bù tài shú xī gōng zuò
items.en: I have only been working at this company for half a year and I am still not very familiar with the work.
items.why: 工作了半年 is a duration up to now, so the adverb 刚 is used. 刚才 would mean a moment ago, and 正在 cannot go with 了半年.

items.q: 我___感冒两天，不用去医院吧？
items.zh: 我刚感冒两天，不用去医院吧？
items.py: wǒ gāng gǎn mào liǎng tiān bù yòng qù yī yuàn ba
items.en: I have only had a cold for two days; I do not need to go to the hospital, do I?
items.why: 感冒两天 is a duration, and with 刚 it means only two days so far. 刚才 cannot be followed by a time span.

items.q: 小王___上班一个星期，很多事情还不会做。
items.zh: 小王刚上班一个星期，很多事情还不会做。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gāng shàng bān yī gè xīng qī hěn duō shì qing hái bù huì zuò
items.en: Xiao Wang has only been at work for a week and cannot do many things yet.
items.why: 上班一个星期 is a span up to now, so 刚 is used. 刚才 cannot be combined with 一个星期.

items.q: 这位病人___住院三天，医生还需要继续观察。
items.zh: 这位病人刚住院三天，医生还需要继续观察。
items.py: zhè wèi bìng rén gāng zhù yuàn sān tiān yī shēng hái xū yào jì xù guān chá
items.en: This patient has only been in hospital for three days and the doctor still needs to keep observing him.
items.why: 住院三天 is a duration up to now, which pairs with 刚. 刚才 refers to minutes ago and cannot sit before 三天.

items.q: 我___锻炼了一个月，腿还是有点儿疼。
items.zh: 我刚锻炼了一个月，腿还是有点儿疼。
items.py: wǒ gāng duàn liàn le yī gè yuè tuǐ hái shi yǒu diǎn r téng
items.en: I have only been working out for a month and my legs still hurt a bit.
items.why: Verb + 了 + a duration is a stretch up to now, so 刚 says it is still short. 刚才 cannot cover a whole month.

items.q: 我们公司___成立两年，需要更多的时间来发展。
items.zh: 我们公司刚成立两年，需要更多的时间来发展。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī gāng chéng lì liǎng nián xū yào gèng duō de shí jiān lái fā zhǎn
items.en: Our company has only been set up for two years and needs more time to develop.
items.why: 成立两年 is a duration up to now, so 刚 is the right word. 刚才 means a few minutes ago and cannot be followed by 两年.

items.q: 他___走了，你没看见吗？
items.zh: 他刚才走了，你没看见吗？
items.py: tā gāng cái zǒu le nǐ méi kàn jiàn ma
items.en: He left a moment ago; did you not see?
items.why: A reported past event that keeps its final 了 goes with the time noun 刚才 (刚 would drop the 了: 他刚走). 常常, 一直 and 每天 do not fit a single departure.

items.q: 我___下班没多久，还没吃饭。
items.zh: 我刚下班没多久，还没吃饭。
items.py: wǒ gāng xià bān méi duō jiǔ hái méi chī fàn
items.en: I got off work only a little while ago and have not eaten yet.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: ___他去洗手间了，现在回来了。
items.zh: 刚才他去洗手间了，现在回来了。
items.py: gāng cái tā qù xǐ shǒu jiān le xiàn zài huí lái le
items.en: He went to the washroom a moment ago; he is back now.
items.why: The clause ends in 了 and is set against 现在, which is the pattern of 刚才 plus a finished event. 刚 does not open a clause before the subject.

items.q: 我___吃完药没多久，一会儿再喝水。
items.zh: 我刚吃完药没多久，一会儿再喝水。
items.py: wǒ gāng chī wán yào méi duō jiǔ yī huì r zài hē shuǐ
items.en: I took my medicine only a little while ago; I will drink water in a while.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: 经理___出去没多久，你五分钟后再来吧。
items.zh: 经理刚出去没多久，你五分钟后再来吧。
items.py: jīng lǐ gāng chū qù méi duō jiǔ nǐ wǔ fēn zhōng hòu zài lái ba
items.en: The manager went out only a little while ago; come back in five minutes.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: 我___起床没多久，还没洗脸。
items.zh: 我刚起床没多久，还没洗脸。
items.py: wǒ gāng qǐ chuáng méi duō jiǔ hái méi xǐ liǎn
items.en: I got up only a little while ago and have not washed my face yet.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: 客户___还在这儿，现在已经走了。
items.zh: 客户刚才还在这儿，现在已经走了。
items.py: kè hù gāng cái hái zài zhè r xiàn zài yǐ jīng zǒu le
items.en: The client was still here a moment ago; he has already left now.
items.why: 还在这儿 is a state at a past moment, set against 现在, so the time noun 刚才 is used. 常常 and 每天 do not fit a single moment.

items.q: 病人___醒过来不久，现在还不能说话。
items.zh: 病人刚醒过来不久，现在还不能说话。
items.py: bìng rén gāng xǐng guò lái bù jiǔ xiàn zài hái bù néng shuō huà
items.en: The patient came round only a little while ago and cannot speak yet.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: 你___说什么了？我没听清。
items.zh: 你刚才说什么了？我没听清。
items.py: nǐ gāng cái shuō shén me le wǒ méi tīng qīng
items.en: What did you say just now? I did not catch it.
items.why: A question about a past utterance with final 了 takes the time noun 刚才. 常常 and 每天 do not fit one remark a moment ago.

items.q: 她___睡着没多久，别吵醒她。
items.zh: 她刚睡着没多久，别吵醒她。
items.py: tā gāng shuì zháo méi duō jiǔ bié chǎo xǐng tā
items.en: She fell asleep only a little while ago; do not wake her.
items.why: 没多久 / 不久 after the verb says the action is only a short stretch behind us, which takes the adverb 刚 with a bare verb and no final 了. 刚才 is a point a few minutes back and does not combine with it; 常常 and 每天 do not fit.

items.q: 我___到公司，经理就找我了。
items.zh: 我刚到公司，经理就找我了。
items.py: wǒ gāng dào gōng sī jīng lǐ jiù zhǎo wǒ le
items.en: I had only just got to the office when the manager came looking for me.
items.why: The pair 刚 ... 就 means no sooner A than B. 刚才 only names a time and cannot link two events with 就.

items.q: 他___坐下，电话就响了。
items.zh: 他刚坐下，电话就响了。
items.py: tā gāng zuò xià diàn huà jiù xiǎng le
items.en: He had only just sat down when the phone rang.
items.why: 刚 in the first clause and 就 in the second link two events that follow at once. 刚才 does not pair with 就.

items.q: 他___打开电脑，老板就叫他去开会。
items.zh: 他刚打开电脑，老板就叫他去开会。
items.py: tā gāng dǎ kāi diàn nǎo lǎo bǎn jiù jiào tā qù kāi huì
items.en: He had only just turned on the computer when the boss called him to a meeting.
items.why: 刚 + verb in the first clause with 就 in the next gives no sooner ... than. 刚才 cannot be the first half of that pair.

items.q: 我___坐下，经理___进来了。
items.zh: 我刚坐下，经理就进来了。
items.py: wǒ gāng zuò xià jīng lǐ jiù jìn lái le
items.en: I had no sooner sat down than the manager came in.
items.why: 刚 ... 就 ... is the fixed pair for two events one right after the other. 刚才 cannot be used, and 才 would imply the second event came late.

items.q: 护士___给我量完体温，医生___来了。
items.zh: 护士刚给我量完体温，医生就来了。
items.py: hù shi gāng gěi wǒ liáng wán tǐ wēn yī shēng jiù lái le
items.en: The nurse had only just finished taking my temperature when the doctor came.
items.why: The first clause takes 刚 and the second takes 就, with 就 after the new subject 医生. 刚才 cannot link the two events.

items.q: 我___想给你发邮件，你的邮件就到了。
items.zh: 我刚想给你发邮件，你的邮件就到了。
items.py: wǒ gāng xiǎng gěi nǐ fā yóu jiàn nǐ de yóu jiàn jiù dào le
items.en: I was just about to email you when your email arrived.
items.why: 刚想 ... 就 ... means I was just about to when something happened. 刚才 names a time and does not form the pair with 就; 每天 and 一直 do not fit a single moment.

items.q: 我___躺下，手机就响了，是公司打来的。
items.zh: 我刚躺下，手机就响了，是公司打来的。
items.py: wǒ gāng tǎng xià shǒu jī jiù xiǎng le shì gōng sī dǎ lái de
items.en: I had only just lain down when my phone rang; it was the office calling.
items.why: 刚 in the first clause and 就 in the second show that the second event followed right away. 刚才 is not an adverb that can combine with 就.

items.q: 他___做完手术，还没完全醒过来，家人就都赶到了医院。
items.zh: 他刚做完手术，还没完全醒过来，家人就都赶到了医院。
items.py: tā gāng zuò wán shǒu shù hái méi wán quán xǐng guò lái jiā rén jiù dōu gǎn dào le yī yuàn
items.en: He had only just come out of surgery and had not fully woken up when his family all rushed to the hospital.
items.why: 刚 in the first clause is answered by 就 in the second, after the subject 家人. 刚才 cannot form this no sooner than pair.

items.q: 会议___开始，客户就提出了一个很难回答的问题。
items.zh: 会议刚开始，客户就提出了一个很难回答的问题。
items.py: huì yì gāng kāi shǐ kè hù jiù tí chū le yī gè hěn nán huí dá de wèn tí
items.en: The meeting had only just started when the client raised a very hard question.
items.why: 刚开始 sets up the first event and 就 introduces the immediate second one. 刚才 does not fit the 刚 ... 就 pattern.

items.q: 他去年___毕业，现在在公司工作。
items.zh: 他去年刚毕业，现在在公司工作。
items.py: tā qù nián gāng bì yè xiàn zài zài gōng sī gōng zuò
items.en: He only graduated last year and now works at a company.
items.why: 刚 follows another time word (去年) and means only just at that time. 刚才 is itself a minutes-ago word and cannot follow 去年.

items.q: 这台电脑是我昨天___买的。
items.zh: 这台电脑是我昨天刚买的。
items.py: zhè tái diàn nǎo shì wǒ zuó tiān gāng mǎi de
items.en: I only bought this computer yesterday.
items.why: 刚 can follow 昨天 to say only just. 刚才 would be a second time word and means minutes ago, which clashes with yesterday.

items.q: 我今天早上___到北京。
items.zh: 我今天早上刚到北京。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang gāng dào běi jīng
items.en: I only arrived in Beijing this morning.
items.why: After 今天早上 the relative adverb 刚 is used. 刚才 cannot follow another time word and means only a few minutes ago.

items.q: 她上个月___来公司，还不认识大家。
items.zh: 她上个月刚来公司，还不认识大家。
items.py: tā shàng gè yuè gāng lái gōng sī hái bù rèn shi dà jiā
items.en: She only joined the company last month and does not know everyone yet.
items.why: 刚 can mean only just on a scale of months when it follows 上个月. 刚才 is limited to minutes ago.

items.q: 我们上星期___开始用这个软件，还不太熟悉。
items.zh: 我们上星期刚开始用这个软件，还不太熟悉。
items.py: wǒ men shàng xīng qī gāng kāi shǐ yòng zhè gè ruǎn jiàn hái bù tài shú xī
items.en: We only started using this software last week and are not very familiar with it yet.
items.why: 上星期 plus 刚 means only just last week. 刚才 cannot follow a time word and does not stretch to a week.

items.q: 我上周___发现自己的血压有点儿高，医生让我少吃盐。
items.zh: 我上周刚发现自己的血压有点儿高，医生让我少吃盐。
items.py: wǒ shàng zhōu gāng fā xiàn zì jǐ de xuè yā yǒu diǎn r gāo yī shēng ràng wǒ shǎo chī yán
items.en: I only found out last week that my blood pressure is a little high, and the doctor told me to eat less salt.
items.why: 刚 follows 上周 to say it was only recently. 刚才 would imply minutes ago and cannot follow 上周.

items.q: 他三年前___开始跑步，现在每天都跑。
items.zh: 他三年前刚开始跑步，现在每天都跑。
items.py: tā sān nián qián gāng kāi shǐ pǎo bù xiàn zài měi tiān dōu pǎo
items.en: He only started running three years ago; now he runs every day.
items.why: 刚 is relative and can follow 三年前 to mean only just at that time. 刚才 cannot follow another time expression.

items.q: 我今天上午___参加完一个会议，下午还有两个等着我。
items.zh: 我今天上午刚参加完一个会议，下午还有两个等着我。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ gāng cān jiā wán yī gè huì yì xià wǔ hái yǒu liǎng gè děng zhe wǒ
items.en: I had only just finished one meeting this morning, and two more are waiting for me this afternoon.
items.why: 刚 follows 今天上午 and marks only just at that time. 刚才 is already a time word of minutes ago and cannot be stacked after 今天上午.

items.q: 这位医生去年___从国外回来，所以对这里的医院还不太了解。
items.zh: 这位医生去年刚从国外回来，所以对这里的医院还不太了解。
items.py: zhè wèi yī shēng qù nián gāng cóng guó wài huí lái suǒ yǐ duì zhè lǐ de yī yuàn hái bù tài liǎo jiě
items.en: This doctor only came back from abroad last year, so he does not know the hospitals here very well yet.
items.why: 刚 follows 去年 and says it was only just, measured against that year. 刚才 cannot follow 去年.

items.zh: 我刚到公司。
items.py: wǒ gāng dào gōng sī
items.en: I have only just got to the office.
items.why: The adverb 刚 goes after the subject, directly before the verb 到.

items.zh: 刚才我在开会。
items.py: gāng cái wǒ zài kāi huì
items.en: I was in a meeting a moment ago.
items.why: 刚才 is a time noun and may stand before or after the subject.

items.zh: 刚才的事你别告诉他。
items.py: gāng cái de shì nǐ bié gào su tā
items.en: Do not tell him about what happened just now.
items.why: 刚才 + 的 + noun is a noun phrase, so the learner has to keep 刚才的事 together as the topic or the object.

items.zh: 他刚才走了。
items.py: tā gāng cái zǒu le
items.en: He left a moment ago.
items.why: 刚才 reports a past event and keeps the final 了; as a time noun it may stand before or after the subject.

items.zh: 我刚来北京两个月。
items.py: wǒ gāng lái běi jīng liǎng gè yuè
items.en: I have only been in Beijing for two months.
items.why: 刚 comes right before the verb, and the duration 两个月 goes after the verb phrase; 刚 may also sit directly before the duration.

items.zh: 我刚到家就下雨了。
items.py: wǒ gāng dào jiā jiù xià yǔ le
items.en: I had only just got home when it started to rain.
items.why: 刚 sits before the first verb and 就 before the second; the two clauses cannot swap.

items.zh: 他去年刚毕业。
items.py: tā qù nián gāng bì yè
items.en: He only graduated last year.
items.why: 刚 follows the other time word 去年 and goes right before the verb.

items.zh: 这件衣服是我昨天刚买的。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì wǒ zuó tiān gāng mǎi de
items.en: I only bought this piece of clothing yesterday.
items.why: 刚 comes after 昨天 and right before 买, inside the 是 ... 的 frame.

items.task: Say he has only just left.
items.zh: 他刚走。
items.py: tā gāng zǒu
items.en: He has only just left.
items.why: Replacing 刚才 ... 了 with 刚 means the bare verb takes no final 了.

items.src_py: wǒ lái běi jīng liǎng tiān le
items.task: Say you have only been in Beijing for two days.
items.zh: 我刚来北京两天。
items.py: wǒ gāng lái běi jīng liǎng tiān
items.en: I have only been in Beijing for two days.
items.why: 刚 goes before the verb with a duration after it, and the final 了 is dropped.

items.src_py: yī shēng dào le bìng rén xǐng le
items.task: Say the patient woke the moment the doctor arrived, using 刚 ... 就.
items.zh: 医生刚到病人就醒了。
items.py: yī shēng gāng dào bìng rén jiù xǐng le
items.en: The patient woke up just as the doctor arrived.
items.why: 刚 goes in the first clause and 就 after the second subject 病人, with 了 kept at the end of the second clause.

items.task: Add 刚才 to ask where you went just now.
items.zh: 你刚才去哪儿了？
items.py: nǐ gāng cái qù nǎ r le
items.en: Where did you go just now?
items.why: 刚才 is a time word and can go before or after the subject.

items.task: Make it negative: you did not hear clearly just now.
items.zh: 我刚才没听清楚。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: I did not hear clearly just now.
items.why: A negated verb takes 刚才 and 没, and the final 了 goes.

items.s_py: wǒ xiàn zài bǐ gāng shū fu duō le
items.zh: 我现在比刚才舒服多了。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài bǐ gāng cái shū fu duō le
items.en: I feel much better now than a moment ago.
items.why: 比 compares two nouns, so it needs 刚才 as the noun; 刚 cannot follow 比.

items.s: 她刚才在这家医院工作一年。
items.s_py: tā gāng cái zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò yī nián
items.zh: 她刚在这家医院工作一年。
items.py: tā gāng zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò yī nián
items.en: She has only been working at this hospital for a year.
items.why: 刚才 cannot be followed by a duration reaching to now; 刚 says it has only been a year.

items.s: 请把刚的会议记录发给我。
items.s_py: qǐng bǎ gāng de huì yì jì lù fā gěi wǒ
items.zh: 请把刚才的会议记录发给我。
items.py: qǐng bǎ gāng cái de huì yì jì lù fā gěi wǒ
items.en: Please send me the minutes of the meeting we just had.
items.why: 刚 cannot take 的 before a noun; the time noun 刚才 is needed.

items.s: 这个药是我刚才昨天买的。
items.s_py: zhè gè yào shì wǒ gāng cái zuó tiān mǎi de
items.zh: 这个药是我昨天刚买的。
items.py: zhè gè yào shì wǒ zuó tiān gāng mǎi de
items.en: I only bought this medicine yesterday.
items.why: Two time words 刚才 and 昨天 cannot stack. After 昨天 the adverb 刚 is used.

items.s_py: gāng de nà gè yī shēng shì shéi
items.zh: 刚才的那个医生是谁？
items.py: gāng cái de nà gè yī shēng shì shéi
items.en: Who was that doctor from a moment ago?
items.why: 刚 is an adverb and cannot modify the noun phrase with 的; 刚才 can.

items.s: 刚才开会开了一个小时。
items.s_py: gāng cái kāi huì kāi le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 刚才开会开了一个小时。
items.py: gāng cái kāi huì kāi le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We were in a meeting for an hour just now.
items.why: Correct. 刚才 can go with a completed stretch of time; it is the span up to now (as in 刚来两天) that needs 刚.

items.s_py: tā gāng cái bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.zh: 他刚才不在办公室。
items.py: tā gāng cái bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: He was not in the office a moment ago.
items.why: Correct. A negated state takes the time noun 刚才.

items.s: 我昨天刚来北京，还没去过长城。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān gāng lái běi jīng hái méi qù guò cháng chéng
items.zh: 我昨天刚来北京，还没去过长城。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān gāng lái běi jīng hái méi qù guò cháng chéng
items.en: I only arrived in Beijing yesterday and have not been to the Great Wall yet.
items.why: Correct. 刚 can follow another time word such as 昨天; 刚才 could not.

items.s: 他刚走，你去追还来得及。
items.s_py: tā gāng zǒu nǐ qù zhuī hái lái de jí
items.zh: 他刚走，你去追还来得及。
items.py: tā gāng zǒu nǐ qù zhuī hái lái de jí
items.en: He has only just left; you can still catch him if you go now.
items.why: Correct. 刚 + bare verb needs no final 了.

items.s: 我刚到医院，医生就来了。
items.s_py: wǒ gāng dào yī yuàn yī shēng jiù lái le
items.zh: 我刚到医院，医生就来了。
items.py: wǒ gāng dào yī yuàn yī shēng jiù lái le
items.en: I had only just got to the hospital when the doctor came.
items.why: Correct. 刚 in the first clause and 就 in the second.

items.s_py: wǒ de tóu bǐ gāng cái téng duō le
items.zh: 我的头比刚才疼多了。
items.py: wǒ de tóu bǐ gāng cái téng duō le
items.en: My head hurts much more than it did a moment ago.
items.why: Correct. 比 is followed by the noun 刚才.

items.s: 他刚刚出去，一会儿就回来。
items.s_py: tā gāng gāng chū qù yī huì r jiù huí lái
items.zh: 他刚刚出去，一会儿就回来。
items.py: tā gāng gāng chū qù yī huì r jiù huí lái
items.en: He has only just gone out and will be back shortly.
items.why: Correct. 刚刚 is the same adverb as 刚, after the subject and before the verb; 就 in the second clause is a different 就 and not the 刚...就 pattern.

items.s_py: gāng cái de huì yì wǒ méi cān jiā
items.zh: 刚才的会议我没参加。
items.py: gāng cái de huì yì wǒ méi cān jiā
items.en: I did not attend the meeting we just had.
items.why: Correct. 刚才的 + noun is fine, and 没 goes with it.

items.s: 我们刚认识一个星期，还不太了解对方。
items.s_py: wǒ men gāng rèn shi yī gè xīng qī hái bù tài liǎo jiě duì fāng
items.zh: 我们刚认识一个星期，还不太了解对方。
items.py: wǒ men gāng rèn shi yī gè xīng qī hái bù tài liǎo jiě duì fāng
items.en: We have only known each other for a week and do not know each other well yet.
items.why: Correct. 刚 + verb + duration, with no final 了.
